model.name: R19.67: Room scenario detail shows type 'Room', speaky name, and clickable Scenario.json link — not bare uuid.
model.description: The /scenario Room detail view (R19.66) currently shows 'unknown' as type label and renders the uuid bare and repeated without a clickable link. FIX: (1) type label = 'Room' (resolved from ior:class), (2) display the room's speaky NAME (model.name), (3) render a CLICKABLE [Scenario.json](…uuid) link to the scenario unit file — not a bare uuid string. Consistent with how other types (Task, Requirement, etc.) render in /scenario.
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "the in-room link to scenario jumps to scenario view with a uuid in the details view but it should be clickable. shows unknown + bare uuid. make it nicer: Room <room-name> + [Scenario.json](…uuid) clickable."
model.refinementOfNote: Refines R19.66 (Room Scenario button opens detail view). R19.66 fixed the route dispatch; R19.67 fixes the RENDERING: type label, speaky name, clickable link instead of bare uuid. Witness: room f672d29b.
